Senses.Explanation: The line locates the scene south of the Xiang River and north of Tan Prefecture, opening Tanyuan’s tower verse with paired geography. Copies center Nanyang Huizhong and preserve Tanyuan’s verse; Xuewu Ke and Lingrui Kuifu raise it as quoted original, while Dounan’s separate verse shows how the geographical line became reusable.
